summary.result: It is considered that the study of the emission factor of pyrolysis melting facility is an important factor in improving the credibility of greenhouse gas inventory in waste incineration sector.
summary.background: In this study, the NSUB2/SUBO emission factor of the facility was developed by measuring the kiln type pyrolysis melting facility.
summary.method: From March 2016 to April 2016, it was measured over a total of two times and NSUB2/SUBO concentrations were measured continuously for 24 hours using a 24 hour continuous measuring instrument (LSE-4405).
